personalizedFeedback.title: SKIN TEXTURE OPTIMIZATION
personalizedFeedback.description:
Your bone structure is quite strong, but your *skin quality* is currently the most significant limiting factor. The presence of acne and inflammatory blemishes creates visual noise that distracts from your symmetry and eye area.
A strict dermatological routine involving *Tretinoin* or *Adapalene* would likely clear the congestion and refine the skin texture, which would immediately lift your overall harmony.

personalizedFeedback.title: LOWER THIRD PROJECTION
personalizedFeedback.description:
While your maxilla is well-developed, your *chin projection* is slightly weak. This creates a slight convexity in your profile that prevents you from achieving a truly "elite" lateral read.
To fix this, a *sliding genioplasty* or a chin implant would move the chin forward, straightening the profile line and creating a more masculine, balanced lower third.

personalizedFeedback.title: PHILTRUM AND LIP HARMONY
personalizedFeedback.description:
Your philtrum is slightly elongated relative to the rest of your lower face. This can make the face look slightly more "stretched" than it actually is.
While this is a minor flaw, *lip fillers* (specifically in the upper lip) or a *lip lift* could shorten the perceived distance between the nose and the mouth, enhancing the "compactness" of the lower face.

personalizedFeedback.title: MAXIMIZING JAW DEFINITION
personalizedFeedback.description:
You have a good gonial angle, but your jaw is *tapered*. To increase the perceived masculinity and "pop" of the jawline, you should focus on maintaining a very low body fat percentage.
Reducing *submental fat* (under the chin) through lean mass gain and strict diet will make the existing bone structure appear sharper and more prominent.

personalizedFeedback.title: BROW AND EYE FRAMING
personalizedFeedback.description:
Your eye area is your strongest asset. To maximize this, ensure your eyebrows are groomed to maintain their *compactness* and thickness without becoming too thin.
Avoid over-plucking the tails of the brows; keeping them slightly fuller and lower will enhance the *brow compactness index* and further emphasize the depth of the eyes.
